title.zh: 将南三宝颜省迪纳斯市镇迪纳斯市镇医院的名称变更为Don Santiago A. Nahial，Sr.纪念医院的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of Dinas Municipal Hospital in the Municipality of Dinas, Province of Zamboanga Del Sur, to Don Santiago A. Nahial, Sr. Memorial Hospital
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of Dinas Municipal Hospital in the Municipality of Dinas, Province of Zamboanga Del Sur, to Don Santiago A. Nahial, Sr. Memorial Hospital
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Dinas Municipal Hospital tại Thị trấn Dinas, Tỉnh Zamboanga Del Sur thành Bệnh viện tưởng niệm Don Santiago A. Nahial, Sr.
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อ Dinas Municipal Hospital ในเทศบาล Dinas, จังหวัด Zamboanga Del Sur เป็นโรงพยาบาลอนุสรณ์ Don Santiago A. Nahial, Sr.
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Dinas Municipal Hospital di Kotamadya Dinas, Provinsi Zamboanga Del Sur menjadi Rumah Sakit Peringatan Don Santiago A. Nahial, Sr.
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Dinas Municipal Hospital di Perbandaran Dinas, Wilayah Zamboanga Del Sur menjadi Hospital Peringatan Don Santiago A. Nahial, Sr.

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1995/ra_7979_1995.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name Dinas Municipal Hospital in the Municipality of Dinas, Province of Zamboanga del Sur, is hereby changed to Don Santiago A. Nahial, Sr. Memorial Hospital.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
